command_or_source: App commit a61093e3fdde8445ce98094398c39f4d2780736b: bash scripts/build.sh; codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 build/Tocode.app; otool -L build/Tocode.app/Contents/MacOS/Tocode; python3 architecture/tools/audit_project.py --target . in governance.
result_summary: App and CLI build successfully; Tocode.app satisfies its designated requirement; MultitouchSupport is loaded dynamically rather than recorded as a direct Mach-O dependency; governance structure and references pass audit.
limitations: Build uses the local macOS 26.6 SDK and an ad-hoc signature with a stable designated requirement.
Use of Apple's private MultitouchSupport framework prevents Mac App Store distribution and requires compatibility checks after macOS upgrades.
